purpose: Product-owned copy of the known-counter-authority ids used by the accepted cached counter-surface measurement. The ids are a SUBSET of the frozen evaluation spec, adopted by reference so the product can measure its own four-leg cached pools without importing evaluation code or changing a frozen artifact.

source.adoption_note: Ids are copied verbatim; the evaluation file is never edited or imported at measurement time.

id_match_rules.method: a frozen authority id matches a rendered row when the alnum-core of any of (row decision_id, canonical_decision_id, docket_number, citation_string_de/fr/it) equals the alnum-core of the frozen id; alnum-core = lowercase, drop every non-alphanumeric character, then strip repeated leading court tokens (bgestger, bstger, bger, bge, bg)

claim_ceiling: This file is a sample of known authorities, not a recall ground truth. It supports a coverage measurement over the product's own rendered pools only.
